items.name: Process Intelligence Webinar (UNILAG Faculty of Computing and Informatics)
items.about: How organisations can use process intelligence and AI to improve decisions and efficiency. Moderated by Dr Babatunde Sawyerr, with Dr Niyi Ogunbiyi and Phiwi Ntsada. Source: unilag.edu.ng (event page lists the Zoom meeting ID and passcode).

items.name: Igbo in the Digital Age (Virtual Roundtable)
items.about: A two-hour virtual roundtable by the nonprofit TokataHQ on how Igbo is left out of everyday technology and what could change that, featuring Pete Edochie and Ugoccie. Price not stated; registration required. Source: luma.com event page.

items.name: Nkata Igbo Panel Discussion, Edition 3: Religion and Igbo Culture
items.about: Panel on how Igbo people can keep their faith while preserving their cultural heritage, hosted by Nkata Igbo (Dr Chigozie Nweke-Eze). Price not stated. Source: luma.com event page.
